authority: Finish names and treatments are reversible delegated production decisions. Canonical edition numbers and rarity tiers come from COLLECTION_REGISTRY.json.
invariants: One edition keeps the same finish key across all three evolution stages.
Finish treatments may change material response, controlled lighting, glazing tint and restrained decorative inlays only.
Architecture, silhouette, amenities, exact mounted stage name, building type and framing must not change.
No finish may add people as focal points, logos, watermarks, captions, token text, stage labels or unsupported geometry.
Every rendered edition-stage image must be visually inspected and have unique bytes, SHA-256, dimensions and permanent URI before metadata release.
